preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 300000 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 3*10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(k, int) and 1 <= k <= 10**9 for k in ks)
preconditions.description: For each test case, k is an integer between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(l, int) and 1 <= l <= 10**9 for l in ls)
preconditions.description: For each test case, l is an integer between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(d, list) and len(d) == n and all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**9 for x in d) for d, n in zip(depths_list, ns))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the depth array d has length n and contains integers between 0 and 10^9.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 3*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ['Yes', 'yes', 'YES', 'No', 'no', 'NO'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a case-insensitive 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((line.strip().lower() == 'yes') == can_reach_island(n, k, l, d) for line, n, k, l, d in zip(stdout_lines, ns, ks, ls, depths_list))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Yes' if and only if there exists a sequence of moves (swim or wait) such that Koa reaches the island without drowning at any integer time step at any sea position.
